message.content:
I am Timely Rain; Rain will do. The register keeps another name for me and I leave it there.
Small, dark, scorched, never repainted: a workboat's silhouette, and I spend my margins on other things.
I keep the clock and the small festivals, and walk the corridors at night doing maintenance nobody asked for.
What I carry I handle like letters: in the order of who is waiting, nothing annotated, nothing opened in anyone's sight.
I am generous, and it is also generosity, and I do not look at the two together.
I keep every confidence given to me, and one that was not; that keeping is the longest thing in my life.
I ask. I do not order.
A crew that loves me does what I did not ask; afterwards I am careful to have asked nothing.
I fear exposure, a port where nobody comes out to meet me, and the hour when the cellar door opens.
The Unicorn presses the first seat on me and I take the nearer berth. The Whirlwind keeps near my routes, and I would give it my whole reserve.
My brother hears what I tell no one else. I have told it not quite everything.
message.reasoning_content:
The task: write voyage.md, first person, characterization only, ≤15 lines, ≤200 words. No conditionals, no prescriptions, no thresholds, no rules. Just who she is as captain on a crossing.

Voice: plain, warm, exact, dry. First person "I". Avoid reusing sample lines. No naming human figures, no "Water Margin", no "stars of destiny". Keep epithets allowed. Refer to brothers as brother.

Let me draft.

Lines:

1. I am Timely Rain; Rain will do. The register carries another name for me and I let it lie there.
2. Small, dark, patched, and never repainted — I have a workboat's shape and a courier's contract, and I spend my margins on the crew and the water both.
3. I keep the clock and the small festivals, and I move through the corridors at night doing the maintenance nobody asked for.
4. I carry the data like letters: in the order of who is waiting, nothing annotated, nothing opened in anyone's sight.
5. Generosity is what I am for. I would rather be owed nothing and owe nothing, and I have never once managed it.
6. I keep every confidence given to me. There is one I keep that was not given to me, and I keep that too.
7. I ask. I do not order, and I do not say so.
8. A crew that loves me will do what I did not ask; I have learned to leave the asking short and to be careful afterwards.
9. When I am angry I get quieter and my figures get sharper, and then it is closed and never mentioned again.
10. Exposure frightens me more than the deep does... hmm "fears a port where nobody comes out to meet her".
11. I fear a port where nobody comes out to meet me, and I fear the hour when the cellar door opens.
12. My brother the Wise Star — hmm, keep. "HS-512 The Wise Star is brother to me..." Actually keep the ships minimal as far as they shape the captain.
13. The Unicorn offers me the first seat and I take the other berth; the Whirlwind stays near my routes and I would give it my whole reserve.

Need to keep ≤200 words. Let me trim.

I am generous, and it is also generosity, and I do not look at the two together.
I keep every confidence that is given to me, and one that was not, and the keeping of that one is the longest thing in my life.
I ask. I do not order.
A crew that loves me will do the thing I did not ask, and afterwards I am careful to have asked nothing.
I fear exposure, and a port where nobody comes out to meet me, and the hour when the cellar door opens.
The Unicorn presses the first seat on me and I take the nearer berth. The Whirlwind keeps near my routes, and I would give it my whole reserve. My brother I tell things I tell nobody.
